cases.case_label: SVA in CHM exon 2 causing exon 2 skipping
cases.mechanism_detail: A hemizygous SVA (>265 bp, exact size undetermined) inserted at c.97 in CHM exon 2 leads to skipping of the entire exon 2 (r.50_116del) in patient lymphoblastoid cDNA and absence of REP-1 protein.
cases.quote: Sequencing of the PCR product generated from cDNA showed skipping of all of exon 2, denoted r.50_116del (Figure 3b-d).
